facts.fact: PMSS pays Rs 2,500 per month for boys and Rs 3,000 per month for girls, paid annually
facts.quote: Amount of Scholarship (Paid annually) Rs. 2500/- p.m. ( For Boys) Rs. 3000/- p.m. ( For Girls)

facts.fact: 5,500 scholarships are given each academic year, split equally: 2,750 for boys and 2,750 for girls
facts.quote: A total number of 5500 wards/ widows of Ex-servicemen are selected for scholarship in each academic year. Scholarships are equally divided amongst boys and girls i.e. 2750 each.

facts.fact: The scholarship is paid for 2 to 5 years depending on the duration of the approved course
facts.quote: Scholarships are paid for a period of two to five years as per the duration of the courses approved by the concerned government regulatory bodies.

facts.fact: PMSS is for higher technical and professional education of dependent wards of Ex-Servicemen / Ex-Coast Guard personnel and their widows
facts.quote: to encourage higher technical and professional education for the dependent wards of Ex-servicemen/ Ex-Coast Guard personnel and their widows.

facts.fact: Only students admitted to the first year in the current year are eligible; lateral entry is excluded
facts.quote: Students who have taken admission in 1 st year i.e. current financial year (except Lateral Entry) are only eligible to apply for PMSS.

facts.fact: At least 60% marks are needed in the Minimum Educational Qualification (10+2 / Diploma / Graduation)
facts.quote: Students should have scored 60% and above in Minimum Educational Qualification (MEQ) i.e. 10+2/ Diploma/ Graduation.

facts.fact: All subjects are counted for the 60%, not the best subjects
facts.quote: All subjects will be taken for calculation of 60% marks including optional subjects also and not out of best subjects.

facts.fact: Fresh PMSS applications for 2026-27 are open online and the last date is 31 December 2026
facts.quote: Fresh Application for PMSS for Academic Year 2026-27 is now open. Eligible students are invited to apply online. Last date to apply is 31 Dec 2026.

facts.fact: Applications are made online on the KSB portal online.ksb.gov.in
facts.quote: Students must apply online on KSB web portal online.ksb.gov.in.

facts.fact: Paper applications are not accepted and one candidate may apply for one course only
facts.quote: Hard copy / paper application will not be entertained. One candidate can apply for one course only.

summary: All PMSS amounts, numbers, duration, eligibility and the 2026-27 window (last date 31 Dec 2026, KSB news of 01 Aug 2026, no later notice) confirmed on ksb.gov.in.
